# GameDrawer

Free offline logic, card, word and arcade games for iPhone and iPad, iOS 17+. No ads, coins, energy timers or required account.

## Release status
- Current App Store release: 1.5, with ten games.
- Next update: 1.6, not yet marked released. Adds Math Crossword as the eleventh game, puzzle hints, Practice after the last life in Sudoku and Nonogram, 35 themes, improved Video Mode layouts and saved Solitaire undo.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gamedrawer-classic-games/id6765536382

## Games in 1.5
Minesweeper, Merge (2048 and Infinite), Nonogram, Sudoku, FreeCell, Klondike Solitaire, Five Letter, Word Grid, Stack and Snake.

## Features
- Every game works offline. No account required to play.
- Video Mode reserves one of six positions for Picture-in-Picture. Requires a video app that supports Picture-in-Picture.
- Sudoku includes 6,000 puzzles across four difficulties. Minesweeper has first-tap safety.
- Stats stay on-device, with JSON backup export/import and optional iCloud sync via Sign in with Apple. Deleting the app removes local-only data.
- Themes and custom colors, with controls for sound, haptics and animations.
